producer_report.summary: Added the full id ee4b0dd1aa6fcd81289dc988d0f7bd38fd7a40ef to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, with a comment that it is the PR #8 multi-job squash excused by the user's choice of D66 (a). Added D67 to docs/decisions.md recording the choice, the tradeoff, the reversal, and that option (c) is not yet adopted. Added a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md noting the exemption. No code, tests or workflows changed. fmt, clippy and test pass.

checks_run.note: Full test suite; one live test ignored because it calls a real model
Confirmed only CHANGELOG.md, athena.toml and docs/decisions.md are modified

open_issues: ee4b0dd's presence in the real repository's history (D60) is unverified here; the history check was not run against the real repository.
Option (c), stopping multi-job squash merges, is not adopted and remains a follow-up decision.
Options (b) and (d) from D66 remain open.
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG wording said the history check 'passes on main' for the commit. I did not verify that, so I reworded it to say the history check no longer judges that commit's content.

My first D67 provenance line said the entry 'passes' D60 validation, implying the commit is in history. I had not checked that, so I changed it to say the user's report places it on main and this change did not verify it.
learnings: [history] exempt in athena.toml is read from the tip's configuration (D61), and each entry must be a full commit id already in history (D60).
D66 is the last decision in docs/decisions.md; the next one is D67.
The git -C form is blocked by policy in this environment; plain git status in the working directory works.
desires: A way to confirm in the real repository that ee4b0dd is an ancestor of main (D60 requires it), since this snapshot does not contain that commit
The history check's output on the real repository, to confirm the exemption makes it pass
